source_doc.title: SK hynix Announces 2Q26 Financial Results（官方 newsroom，Micron 反路徑的替代供給規模證據）
source_doc.permission_basis: Official public SK hynix newsroom press release; canonical URL retained, only research-relevant excerpts stored.

sources.quote: 79.3187 trillion won in revenues, 60.5426 trillion won in operating profit (with an operating margin of 76%)
The company began mass shipments of HBM4 in the second quarter and will ramp up production in the second half of the year.
The company has finalized Long-Term Agreements (LTAs) with around 10 customers, including key strategic partners

claims.statement: SK hynix began mass shipments of HBM4 in Q2 2026 with production ramp planned for H2 2026, and reported record 2Q26 results (KRW 79.3187T revenue, KRW 60.5426T operating profit, 76% operating margin) — the HBM alternative to Micron is real, shipping at scale, and highly profitable.
claims.disproof_condition: Downgrade if HBM4 ramp is delayed/recalled in later quarters or reported HBM shipment mix falls materially.

claims.statement: SK hynix has finalized Long-Term Agreements with around 10 customers including key strategic partners — customer-side lock-in on the competing HBM supply path, which bounds how much share is contestable by Micron in the LTA window (and vice versa).
claims.disproof_condition: Update if LTA count/coverage is restated, or if disclosed LTA terms turn out to be non-binding framework agreements.
